_comment: Adversarial slice for the graph-vs-flat ablation (plan/eval.md section D): questions where mechanics and oracle wording diverge. Each has a witness (must be found) and an 'absent' foil (textually similar, mechanically wrong - must NOT be returned). Disjoint from all prior sets; RulesGuru remains unread.

questions.q: cards with an activated ability that sacrifices a creature as part of its activation cost
questions.why_adversarial: cost-sacrifice vs effect-sacrifice: both oracle texts contain 'sacrifice a creature'

questions.q: cards that make abilities triggering on a creature dying trigger an additional time
questions.why_adversarial: trigger-doubling static vs an ordinary death trigger: both texts are about creatures dying

questions.q: enchantments that double the number of tokens you create
questions.why_adversarial: Procession's text never says 'double' (it says 'twice that many'); Doubling Cube says 'double' but doubles mana

questions.q: creatures with an ability that requires tapping themselves as a cost
questions.why_adversarial: the tap COST is the {T} symbol, not the word 'tap'; Twiddle says 'tap' but taps as an effect

questions.q: counterspells that can counter any kind of spell
questions.why_adversarial: unrestricted vs restricted ValidTgts: 'counter target spell' is a substring of 'counter target creature spell'
